title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the System Settings view permission but not the…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain an authorization vulnerability where users with the System Settings view permission but without the Assets view permission can access sensitive asset-related information. This includes asset names, identifiers, app names, tenant names, and ingestion schedule settings. The flaw arises because the ingestion schedule view does not properly enforce the Assets view permission before displaying asset-derived data.
